summary: Reads a high-resolution timestamp via QPCTimestampReadWrapper, computes the delta from the previously stored timestamp, stores the new timestamp, and returns the delta scaled by per-instance factors.

local_names.scale_divisor: this+0x0 factor applied to the low delta dword
local_names.scale_multiplier: this+0x4 (untracked) factor applied to the high delta dword

operations.description: Capture the previous timestamp from the two dwords at this+0x20 and this+0x24 into locals.
Call QPCTimestampReadWrapper(this, &lo, &hi) to read the current high-resolution timestamp.
Compute the 64-bit delta as the current timestamp minus the previously stored timestamp (this+0x20/this+0x24).
Store the new timestamp dwords back into this+0x20 and this+0x24.
Scale the delta into seconds: divide the low delta dword by this+0x0 and add the high delta dword multiplied by this+0x4 (the multiplier field at +4 is not tracked in this packet).
Return the scaled delta as a double.

unresolved: The purpose of the read-only field this+0x8 is not observed in this function; its meaning is unknown.
The exact scale semantics of this+0x0 and this+0x4 (frequency conversion factors) are DERIVED from the structural twin note, not confirmed.
